description: Port the requested qr_mega_la_tc structure into the fish n=512 path as a low-footprint one-CTA look-ahead megakernel: replace WMMA with native sm_100a tcgen05/TMEM plus TMA, stream 128-column tiles, retain FP32 panel/T arithmetic and compensated TF32 updates, and cut the old 210 KiB shared-memory footprint.
Staged the supplied qr_mega_la_tc one-CTA look-ahead structure and safe dense-only routing; Python import failed on a generated patch-marker artifact before NVRTC.

Ported supplied one-CTA NB32 look-ahead kernel into the fish n512 homogeneous-safe route; all 22 tests and three guards pass. Original WMMA/tf32x3 path uses 210 KiB shared memory and measured dense n512 53733.408 us, full geomean 1580.348465 us versus parent 1234.320 us.

Replaced WMMA/full n512x32 staging with a 190384-byte 4-warp tcgen05/TMEM 128-column tiled update and compensated TF32; static validation rejected four prose uses of the banned word stream before NVRTC or execution.

Native 190384-byte tcgen05/TMEM 128-column tiled kernel compiled and executed. Exact B640 differential guard failed all 8 randomized dense inputs (factor residual 98.5-117, scaled about 3970-4560); mixed failed 2/8. Other shapes and routing guards remained clean, isolating the defect to tcgen05 operand/output layout.

Isolated tcgen05 W=V^T*C with a full-FP32 SIMT V*W' epilogue. B640 dense still failed 8/8 and residual increased to 230-264 (scaled 9120-10600), proving the first tcgen05 product or its TMEM load/layout is wrong; non-target routes stayed clean.

Assigned tcgen05/TMEM work to complete warps 0-3 and added explicit TMEM lane-group addresses. Exact B640 dense still failed 8/8 at residual 98.5-119 (scaled about 3970-4870), essentially unchanged; route and off-grid guards remained clean.

Moved the generic-to-async shared proxy fence onto every operand writer before the named barrier. B640 dense still failed 8/8 with the same 98.5-120 residual, ruling out async-proxy visibility; all non-target guards remained clean.

Corrected the first product to padded M128 after NVIDIA datapath docs showed non-WS M64 splits each 16-row slice across two TMEM lane regions. Native 190384-byte tcgen05 kernel passes all 22 tests and three guards. Dense n512 measured 75552.096 us; full geomean 1623.405129 us, slower than the 53733.408 us WMMA port.

Double-buffered two 8-deep tcgen05 operand sets in 206768 bytes shared memory and grouped six compensated MMAs per completion barrier. Full validation passes; dense n512 improved 75552.096 to 75155.537 us (0.52%), full geomean 1622.441309 us.

Restored M64 for V^T*C and unpacked NVIDIA Layout F correctly: warp0 lanes 0-15 hold rows 0-15, warp1 lanes 32-47 hold rows 16-31. Full validation passes; dense n512 improved 75155.537 to 71839.384 us (4.41%), geomean 1614.619501 us.

Diagnostic plain-TF32 tcgen05 path removed residual cross-product MMAs and returned to 190384 bytes shared memory. All tests and guards still pass. Dense n512 improved 71839.384 to 66400.586 us (7.57%); geomean 1605.173550 us. This is a performance ceiling, not strict compensated-TF32 brief compliance.

Widened native tile to N256, allocated 256 TMEM columns, and transformed W in place for a 198576-byte footprint. Non-target tests passed, but the first exact B640 call raised CUDA illegal memory access; N256 tcgen/TMEM configuration is not viable in this kernel.

Retried widened path at N192 with a 256-column TMEM allocation and 186288-byte shared footprint. It still raised an illegal memory access on the first exact B640 target call, so the issue is common to wide allocation/in-place changes rather than the N256 descriptor.

Isolated in-place W to -T^T W at known-good N128/TMEM128, reducing shared memory to 174000 bytes. Exact B640 still raised illegal memory access, proving W/Wprime aliasing is unsafe in this kernel; wide tcgen descriptors were not the root cause.

Used legal N192 tcgen descriptors with separate W/Wprime buffers, a 256-column TMEM allocation, and 210864 bytes shared memory. Full validation passes. Dense n512 regressed from N128 66400.586 to 68683.757 us; geomean 1607.025196 us, so N128 remains best.

Added dedicated-mbarrier cp.async.bulk TMA loads for every contiguous n512 panel, retaining compensated TF32 tcgen05/TMEM updates in 206776 bytes shared memory. Full validation passes. Dense n512 improved 71839.384 to 69464.373 us (3.31%); geomean 1614.242631 us.

Final strict candidate ba348f84f: one-CTA NB32/N128 look-ahead QR with native sm100a tcgen05/TMEM compensated TF32 updates and mbarrier TMA panel loads, 206776-byte shared footprint. All 22 tests and three guards pass. Dense B640 n512 69464.373 us; full geomean 1614.242631 us versus parent 1234.320 and WMMA port 1580.348. nsys: qr_mega_la_tc 69.791289 ms (99.9%), route stats 38.752 us; profile brief-0-trial-15-ba348f84f3a5036ca0f2e9013151ac03de263007.nsys-rep. Plain-TF32 diagnostic ab3c8acd7 also validates and reaches 66400.586 us / 1605.173550, but does not satisfy strict compensation. No leaderboard submission was made.

Port the requested qr_mega_la_tc structure into the fish n=512 path as a low-footprint one-CTA look-ahead megakernel: replace WMMA with native sm_100a tcgen05/TMEM plus TMA, stream 128-column tiles, retain FP32 panel/T arithmetic and compensated TF32 updates, and cut the old 210 KiB shared-memory footprint.

Replaced two full-height NB32 panels with one streamed NB16 panel, strict compensated tcgen05 updates, 83,640 B shared memory, and a 2xSM launch grid. Full validation/guards passed, but loss of look-ahead and doubled panel count regressed dense n512 from 69,464 to 135,571 us; geomean 1705.509 us.

Diagnostic plain-TF32 version of the validated one-panel NB16 topology reduced shared memory from 83,640 to 67,256 B and removed residual MMAs. Full validation/guards passed. Dense n512 improved 135,570.918 to 125,840.566 us (7.18%), geomean 1694.410 us, confirming sequential panel/barrier structure dominates.

Restored strict compensated look-ahead with one resident NB16 panel: direct-global WY updates the next panel, upper warpgroup factors it in Acm while lower warpgroup runs tcgen05 bulk updates. 84,984 B shared and full validation/guards passed. Dense n512 improved sequential strict 135,570.918 to 121,152.201 us, but direct-global panel work and 32 phases remain much slower than NB32 two-panel look-ahead.

Two shared NB16 look-ahead panels plus compact strict CT64 tcgen05 operands fit in 101,368 B, targeting two CTAs/SM. Full validation/guards passed. Dense n512 improved one-panel global-backed look-ahead 121,152.201 to 111,956.566 us, showing global panel factoring costs ~8%, but narrow tensor tiles and 32 panels remain dominant; geomean 1677.053 us.

Kept two NB16 shared look-ahead panels and CT128 but reused one strict operand stage, committing/waiting every K=8. Same 101,368 B footprint as CT64 and full validation/guards passed. Dense n512 regressed 111,956.566 to 124,732.714 us; doubled tcgen05 K synchronization outweighed wider tile reuse. Geomean 1690.760 us.

Diagnostic plain-TF32 CT128 restored two 8-deep stages at the same 101,368 B footprint as single-stage strict. Full validation/guards passed. Dense n512 improved 124,732.714 to 111,986.196 us but merely tied strict CT64 111,956.566 us; geomean 1676.168 us, so compensation is not the main remaining limit.

Continuation exhausted the requested <=110-KiB/two-CTA topology. Strict one-panel sequential 6908bca19 (83.64 KiB) validated but dense n512=135570.918 us; true one-panel global-backed look-ahead 7b3b83a53 (84.98 KiB) validated and improved to 121152.201 us. Best strict low-footprint control 5166c0647 uses two narrow NB16 panels plus compact CT64 at 101.37 KiB and reached 111956.566 us. Strict CT128 single-stage a53b352a9 regressed to 124732.714 us. Validated plain ceilings were 125840.566 us (one panel) and 111986.196 us (two-panel CT128). NCU proves two-CTA residency: steady 23.7% occupancy vs 25% theoretical, but 86.9% no-eligible cycles, 46.9% barrier stalls, 35.1% long-scoreboard stalls; reports trial16 and trial21 under profiles. Therefore occupancy is real but NB16 synchronization/tile overhead overwhelms it; prior ba348 strict NB32 remains much faster at 69464.373 us. No leaderboard submission was made.
